    • findIdsOfProjectsCurrentUserIsMemberOf

      public List<Long> findIdsOfProjectsCurrentUserIsMemberOf()
      Retrieve the ids of the projects the current user is a member of.

      We do not load the java objects. Just work with the ids. Two reasons : 1. the ids are enough, so it is lighter + 2. prevent from loading object the user is not allowed to read

      Returns:
      the ids of the matching projects
